newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.9 billion yuan from 1.8 billion yuan on Thursday with the 60-day contract again the most active.
The rise in turnover was triggered by a report that the central bank would expand open market operations in future, traders said.

State media on Friday quoted deputy governor Chen Yaoxian as saying that China's central bank will increasingly rely on open market operations in future and move away from administrative measures to control money supply.

"It means the central bank will pay more attention to the interbank market and the CHIBOR," a trader said. "But if no detailed measures follows, the rates will not be influenced greatly in the next few days."
